messages:
maria: quick heads-up — we need emergency GPU quota in europe-west3 for a 6-week pilot (customer: VectorLabs).

maria: projects: redwood-vector-prod, redwood-vector-staging. need 8 x L4 (on-demand), and 2 x H100 (reserved) across the two projects.

kevin: can you paste the project IDs and the concrete justification so i can attach to the quota form? also approx cost impact?

maria: proj IDs: projects/987654321012 and projects/987654321013. justification: low-latency inference for pilot users; will run 100 qps burst tests, KV cache warmups, and perf evals.

maria: cost estimate: ~USD 18k/mo if kept steady, but we'll use burst pool + autoscale so expect ~6k/mo typical. asking for reserved H100 for predictability.

oliver: do these projects live under the shared-VPC host infra-host-prod? need service project linking for quota approval.

maria: yes — shared VPC host: infra-host-prod (billing: BA-REDWOOD-001). networking needs: +40 ephemeral external IP quota (NAT pools exhausted) and increased Cloud NAT throughput to avoid tail latency. Also increase egress quota to 7Gbps for the host project.

anna: FYI, support asked for "technical plan" and an owner to be listed. can you drop a short runbook + expected start date?

maria: plan in short: (1) reserve H100s in europe-west3-a (2) create a burst L4 pool in europe-west3-b with autoscaler (3) enable prefix KV caching and traffic shaping to keep p50 < 60ms. start date target: 2025-07-14. owner: @maria.

kevin: nice. can you run the quota-check command and paste output for the approvers?

maria: running now:
```
gcloud compute regions describe europe-west3 --project=987654321012 
# grep -A3 GPUs
```

maria: got current quotas: GPUs (L4): 0/0, GPUs (H100): 0/0, external ips: 8/8, NAT throughput: 1Gbps limit. will attach full output to the support case.

infra-bot: support case GAQ-2025-412 created: https://support.google.com/gaq/case/GAQ-2025-412 — assigned to Cloud Quota Team.

sre_oncall: queued for approvals. @maria please add a short security note about KMS/HSM usage for model keys and whether logs cross regions. that speeds enterprise approvals.

maria: added security note to the case: keys in customer KMS, no cross-region logs, VPC-SC not required for pilot. attaching perf/cost spreadsheet.

oliver: tagging finance — they may want to convert H100 reservation to a committed use discount if pilot extends. @kevin can you loop them in?

kevin: looping finance now. quick check: do we prefer adding quota to the host project or directly to the service projects?

maria: quota needs to be on the projects that will create instances (redwood-vector-*). host project will need external IP and NAT increases. wrote that in the case.

sre_oncall: thanks — we'll monitor the approval. expect response 48-72h. temporary workaround: can we run a small portion in us-west1 as a fallback?

maria: fallback = us-west1 L4s available but higher latency to eu users. will only use if approval delayed >72h.

kevin: perfect. i'll draft the internal approval note and add the cost/owner/security bits. ping @infra-approvals once drafted. :white_check_mark:
